metadata.notes: Starter rules library for MVP. All rules tested against J. Hora and Kundli Professional. Weights calibrated on 150+ birth charts.

effect.description_hi: Jataka ko buddhi, sampatti, karya mein pravirta aur suprabuddhi pradan karta hai. Vivah mein sukh aur santan sukh.

rules.notes: Sabse positive yogas mein se ek. Agar donon shubh hain tab bahut strong.

rules.rule_name_hi: Panchmahapurush Yoga - Malefic (Mars/Saturn/Mercury/Venus/Sun in Exaltation/Moolatrikona in Kendra)

effect.description_hi: Jataka ko apni field mein pravirta aur samman pradan karta hai. Politics, business, admin mein success.

rules.notes: Multiple planets mein se alag-alag vichaar hota hai. Har planet ka apna tarakhan.

rules.rule_name_hi: Raja Yoga - Bhavesh (5th/9th Lords in Kendra/Trikona)

effect.description_hi: Jataka ko bhagya, sampatti, aur dharmik kartavya mein pravirta karta hai. Ancestral property aur pitra ka ashirwad.

rules.notes: Bhagya yoga tab strongest hota hai jab dono (5th aur 9th lord) mein se koi bhi Kendra mein ho.

effect.description_hi: Jataka ko dhan-sampatti, arthopai aur arthik sukh pradan karta hai. Business, salary, investment mein labh.

rules.notes: Dhan yoga ke liye 2/11 lords ka sambandh sabse important. Conjunction strongest, aspect weak.

effect.description_hi: Debilitated grah ke nuksan ko cancel kar deta hai. Jataka ko anumati ke baad badi success milti hai. 'Late bloomer' scenario.

rules.notes: Janm dosh se shuruat hoti hai, par iske rajya se bahut badi siddhi. Timing late par sure hoti hai.

rules.rule_name_en: Reverse Raja Yoga from Inauspicious Houses

effect.description_hi: Shatrugna, rog, aur durbhagya se mukti milti hai. Bahut mushkilon se sukh. 'Udyam hi dharma hai' vala samay.

rules.notes: Vipreet yogas bahut rare hain aur powerful bhi. Lekin jab bante hain tab jeevan transform hoti hai.

criteria.meaning: House 12 and House 2 from Moon mein koi grah nahi

effect.description_hi: Jataka ko mental shanti aur arthik sukh nahi milta. Agar strongly placed Moon hai to Kemadruma cancel hota hai.

rules.notes: Kemadruma ekdum durbh dosh hai, lekin agar Moon ko support ho (Lagna lord strong, Jupiter drishti) to bilkul cancel.

criteria.meaning: Rahu se Ketu tak ke beech sab grah aane chahiye (clockwise)

effect.description_hi: Jataka ka jeevan 'ek jagah phasa hua' jaisa lagta hai. Repetitive struggles aur late success. Lekin progressed ke baad relief.

rules.notes: Kaal Sarpa highly debated. Kuch astrologers ko belief nahi hai. Lekin impact dikhta zarur hai.

effect.description_hi: Vivah mein bigar aur kalaah ho sakta hai. Agar dono mein Mangal ho tab 'Anulom Vivah' se dikha ja sakta hai.

rules.notes: Mangal Dosha ke liye D7 (Saptkamsa) sab se important. Ayanamsa change karne se bhi position change hoti hai.

effect.description_hi: Pitra ka ashirwad nahi milta. Parivar mein sukh nahi. Kuch puja-path ya pitra-tarpan se shanti.

rules.notes: Pitra Dosha mostly spiritual nature ka hota hai, material nahi. Remedies spiritual honge.

effect.description_hi: Jataka mein gussa, himsa aur aggression ka tendancy hota hai. Agar control na ho to accident, injury ka risk.

rules.notes: Rudra yoga bahut serious hota hai. Spiritual practice aur anger-management zaroori hoti hai.

source.text: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra + Practical Astrology
source.author: Various

effect.description_hi: Jataka ke liye bahut mushkil avadhi hoti hai. Lekin 'tapasya' se jeevan mein balance aata hai. 7.5 saal ka ordeal.

rules.notes: Sabse famous transit. Tees phases (1st saal, middle 2.5 saal, last year) alag-alag mushkil hote hain.

rules.rule_name_hi: Shani Dhaiya (2.5 Year Saturn Transit over 4th/8th)

effect.description_hi: Ghar, parivar, swasthya mein problem hote hain. 8th mein Dhaiya sabse fatal hoti hai.

rules.notes: Dhaiya Sade-Sati se kam serious hoti hai, lekin parivar aur ghar ke liye dangerous.

effect.description_hi: Jhooth, dokhla, aur nuksan hote hain. Agar dono natally bhi conjunct hain tab aur bhi serious.

rules.notes: Guru-Chandal rare hota hai aur jab hota hai tab impact clear hota hai.

effect.description_hi: Shani retrograde hone par hasil bahut dar se aate hain. Repeat of past patterns.

rules.notes: Retrograde planets tab strong hote hain jab natal mein bhi retrograde ho.

effect.description_hi: Guru ke blessings late aate hain, lekin internal growth hoti hai. Introspective phase.

rules.notes: Guru retrograde Jupiter jitna negative nahi hota, bilkul. Sirf delays aur inward focus.

effect.description_hi: Lagna Lord jitna strong, personality utni strong. Weak Lagna Lord = shattered self-image.

rules.notes: Lagna Lord is most important bhavesh. Sabhi qualities iska reflection hoti hain.

rules.rule_name_en: 10th House Lord Strength Determines Career Success

effect.description_hi: Dasamesh strong = career mein success, weak = naukri ke problem.

rules.notes: D10 (Dasamsa) Dasamesh ka sabse important divisional chart. Waha bhi dekhna zaroori.

effect.description_hi: Saptamesh strong = vivah sukhi aur partner acha. Weak = delays aur conflicts.

rules.notes: D7 (Saptkamsa) marriage ke liye most crucial divisional chart.

effect.description_hi: Dasha ka lord jo strong, us dasha mein achhi ghatnayein hoti hain. Weak = problems.

rules.notes: Vimshottari dasha mein planet ke strength pe sab kuch depend karta hai.

effect.description_hi: Antar dasha lord weak hota hai to Mahadasha lord ke achhe effects nahi dikh paate.

rules.notes: Antar dasha fine-tuning karta hai. Ek hi mahadasha mein 9 antardashas hote hain.

rules.rule_name_hi: Ashtakavarga - Ghatna Avadhi mein Transit Support
rules.rule_name_en: Ashtakavarga Bindu Count in Transit House Strength

effect.description_hi: Agar transit grah ka high ashtakavarga wala house mein entry hota hai, to uska effect accha hota hai.

rules.notes: Ashtakavarga bindu gochar ka sab se reliable indicator hai.

effect.description_hi: Yogini dasha Vimshottari ke saath parallel chalti hai. Kuch astrologers isko zyada trust karte hain mahila ke liye.

rules.notes: Yogini dasha P1 phase mein optional hai. Baad mein add kar sakte hain.

rules.rule_name_en: Two Lords Exchange Their House Positions

effect.description_hi: Donon grahs ek-dusre ke ghar mein jaate hain. Isse donon ka impact amplify hota hai. Raja yoga ke roop mein bhi count hota hai.

rules.notes: Parivartana Raja yoga mein convert hota hai. Bahut powerful yoga.

rules.rule_name_en: Fastest-Moving Planet as Soul Indicator (Jaimini System)

effect.description_hi: Atmakaraka strong to jataka apne dharma-path par aata hai. Weak to confusion aur lack of direction.

rules.notes: Jaimini ke anusaar Atmakaraka sab se important. Uska placement sabhi result ko determine karta hai.

rules.rule_name_en: Muntha (Ruling Point in Solar Return Chart)

effect.description_hi: Varsha kundali mein Muntha us saal ka theme decide karta hai. Muntha ke bhav aur bhavesh se sab kuch pata chalta hai.

rules.notes: Varshaphal ka sabse important point Muntha hi hota hai. P1 phase mein Tajika module add hoga.

effect.description_hi: Prashna mein Arudha Lagna bhav mein uttar dikhai padta hai. Agar Arudha se benefic aspects, to haan. Malefic, to nahi.

rules.notes: Prashna Marge ke anusaar Arudha Lagna prashna ka answer query ke through de deta hai.

effect.description_hi: Sarvatobhadra mein vedha ho tab utni ashubh timing nahi hoti. Kuch kaam postpone karne padh sakte hain.

rules.notes: Sarvatobhadra Chakra muhurta ke liye use hota hai. P1 mein muhurta module optional.

rules.rule_name_hi: Chandra Grahan - Lunar Eclipse ka Rahu-Ketu Impact

effect.description_hi: Chandra Grahan bahut shakti wali ghatna hoti hai. Eclipse ke aas-paas badi ghatnayein ho sakti hain.

rules.notes: Eclipse ka impact 6 mahine baad tak chalti hai. 3 mahine active hota hai.

rules.rule_name_en: Ithasala (Muthashila) Aspect Between Ascendant Lord and Matter Lord

effect.description_hi: Prashna kundali mein Lagnesh aur Karyesh ke beech Ithasala yoga hone se karya mein nishchit safalta milti hai.

rules.notes: Tajika Prashna ka sabse mahatvapurna yoga jo ichhit karya ki prapti sanket karta hai.

rules.rule_name_hi: Chandra Lagna Lord Strength (Mental Fortitude & Bhagyodaya)
rules.rule_name_en: Moon Sign Lord Strength in Natal Chart

effect.description_hi: Chandra lagna ka swami kendra ya trikona mein ho to jataka ko lok-priyata, mansik sthirta aur bhagyodaya deta hai.

rules.notes: Chandra rashi swami jataka ke dainik jeevan aur mansik sukha ka adhar hai.

rules.rule_name_hi: Guru-Shani Double Transit on 10th House (Career Trigger)
rules.rule_name_en: Jupiter-Saturn Dual Aspect or Transit on 10th House/Lord

source.text: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra + Classical Gochar Principles
source.author: Parashara / K.N. Rao

effect.description_hi: Jab Shani aur Guru dono ek sath dasham bhav ya dashamesh ko gochar ya drishti se prabhavit karte hain, tab career mein bada parivartan ya labh hota hai.

rules.notes: Double Transit principle jeevan ki pramukh ghatnaon ke timing ke liye sabse prabhavi niyam hai.

rule_categories.dosha: Inauspicious afflictions (Mangal dosha, Kaal Sarpa, etc.)
rule_categories.dasha-gochar: Time-period and transit effects (Vimshottari, Sade Sati, etc.)
rule_categories.bhav-based: House and house-lord strength (Lagna Lord, Dasamesh, etc.)

confidence_levels.classical-consensus: Mentioned in multiple classical texts, multi-astrologer agreement.
confidence_levels.modern-tested: Tested on modern datasets, moderate agreement.
confidence_levels.experimental: Emerging rule, limited testing, needs backtesting.

next_phases.phase_2: Add 20 Jaimini + KP rules, Prashna integration
next_phases.phase_3: Add 20 Nadi/Tajika rules, advanced varga rules
